name: Zone info - Bright Data Docs
snippet: Use the Bright Data Account Management API to zone info. GET /zone returns 200 OK with zone or account configuration data as JSON.

name: All zones - Bright Data Docs
snippet: Use the Bright Data Account Management API to all Zones. GET /zone/get_all_zones returns 200 OK with zone or account configuration data as JSON.

name: Active zones - Bright Data Docs
snippet: Use the Bright Data Account Management API to active Zones. GET /zone/get_active_zones returns 200 OK with zone or account configuration data as JSON.

name: Add a zone - Bright Data Docs
snippet: Use the Bright Data Account Management API to add a Zone. POST /zone returns 200 OK with zone or account configuration data as JSON.

name: Zone permission - Bright Data Docs
snippet: Use the Bright Data Account Management API to zone Permission. GET /zone/permissions returns 200 OK with zone or account configuration data as JSON.
